SYN-F001.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A lip seal for a rotating shaft has a garter spring that presses the lip against the shaft. The spring tension is chosen so the lip keeps contact during start-up.

SYN-F002.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A coolant pump for a vehicle uses a mechanical face seal. Vibration dampers on the pump housing reduce the load on the seal faces.

SYN-F003.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A stent frame keeps steady radial force on the vessel wall while the patient moves, because nickel-titanium struts recover their shape after each deformation without any external power.

SYN-F004.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A watch case gasket is compressed by a threaded back cover. The gasket material keeps its elasticity over many years of daily wear.

SYN-F005.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A window frame seal uses a hollow elastomer profile filled with air at atmospheric pressure, so the seal follows the frame as the building sways in strong wind.

SYN-F006.source_text: SYNTHETIC. A battery enclosure gasket is held by spring clips placed every five centimetres along the lid.

searches.brief_text: SYNTHETIC. A small pump seal starts to leak after long periods of strong vibration. We need a way to keep the sealing contact pressure steady without adding a heavy spring or a power supply.

rationales.what_it_does: Keeps a steady outward force on a soft wall while the body moves.
rationales.transferable_mechanism: A superelastic element that recovers its shape could hold seal contact pressure under vibration without a heavy spring or power.
quotes: keeps steady radial force on the vessel wall while the patient moves
recover their shape after each deformation without any external power

rationales.what_it_does: A seal profile that follows a moving frame.
rationales.transferable_mechanism: A pressurised hollow profile could follow a vibrating seal seat.
quotes: the seal follows the frame as the building sways in strong wind
the hollow profile is filled with nitrogen at high pressure
